    1. getMember()

Interface ReflectiveIntrospection.ReflectivePropertyMember<B>

Type Parameters:
B - The bean type
All Superinterfaces:
AnnotationMetadataProvider, AnnotationSource, ArgumentCoercible<Object>, BeanPropertyMember<B,Object>, Named
Enclosing interface:
ReflectiveIntrospection<T>
public static interface ReflectiveIntrospection.ReflectivePropertyMember<B> extends BeanPropertyMember<B,Object>
A member of a property, with the field or method reflection read it from.

BeanProperty.getMembers() reports these for every reflective property: a member is described only when it is asked for, so a description that never asks for one pays nothing for them.

Since:
5.2.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
